Reflection on the frontier: the archive now has a stable ordering. Asset-light organic scaling plus the MIN(cash level, accrual quality) gate gives the best alpha and t-alpha in the archive (6.9%, t 4.83), while the single MA cash gate gives the best alpha/Sharpe balance (6.6%, t 4.81, Sharpe 0.616) and the brand-inclusive leg gives the best slope and Sharpe (fmb 5.39, 0.617). A consistent trade-off has emerged: every additional conditioner adds roughly 0.2–0.3 points of annualized alpha but costs Sharpe, because tighter gates concentrate the extreme portfolios and raise spread volatility — the liquidity gate is the extreme case (alpha 6.8% but Sharpe 0.387, fmb 4.07), and the triple MIN gate also gave back Sharpe with no alpha gain. So further gate-stacking is exhausted. The unexploited dimensions are (i) the two leg upgrades that have never been combined, (ii) the smoothing horizon of the gate, which is the natural lever on spread stability, and (iii) two structural questions never tested: whether the two intangible legs should be conjunctive rather than differenced, and whether the outer transform should preserve tail magnitude.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Brand-Inclusive Asset-Light Mix
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(SUB(RANK(RATIO(ADD(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), TS_SUM(COALESCE(xad, 0), 5)), SUB(at, COALESCE(intan, 0)))), RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(intan, 0), at)))), RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)))
HYPOTHESIS: The complete stock of self-created intangibles — research plus brand — measured per dollar of tangible assets is the sharpest available measure of hidden capital, and it is credible when cash productivity is high.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The two best-performing leg refinements have never been combined: brand inclusion produced the archive's best FMB slope and Sharpe, while asset-light scaling produced the best t-alpha, and each was validated separately against the same single-gate baseline. Because one change widens the economic definition of the numerator and the other corrects the denominator, they operate on different sources of measurement error and should be complementary. Keeping the simple MA cash gate preserves the Sharpe, which the stacked gates erode.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Complete Hidden Capital On Cash And Accruals
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(SUB(RANK(RATIO(ADD(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), TS_SUM(COALESCE(xad, 0), 5)), SUB(at, COALESCE(intan, 0)))), RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(intan, 0), at)))), MIN(RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), RANK(NEG(RATIO(SUB(ib, oancf), at)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Maximum alpha should come from pairing the most complete measure of self-created intangible capital with the strongest credibility condition: cash generation that is both large and consistent with reported earnings.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This is the direct alpha-maximizing combination of the three best validated components — brand-inclusive numerator, tangible-asset denominator, and the MIN(cash, accrual) gate that currently holds the record alpha of 6.9% with t 4.83. Running it alongside Signal 1 isolates exactly what the accrual condition adds once the intangible leg is fully specified, which is the key decision for the final generation. If alpha rises above 7% with t-alpha above 4.8 and Sharpe near 0.55, this becomes the headline signal.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Asset-Light Mix On Five-Year Cash State
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(SUB(RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), SUB(at, COALESCE(intan, 0)))), RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(intan, 0), at)))), RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: Cash productivity is a slow-moving structural attribute; measuring it over five years rather than three identifies the firm's persistent state and reduces the rebalancing noise that a shorter window introduces.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The recurring cost of every gate refinement has been Sharpe, i.e. spread volatility driven by portfolio churn, and the gate horizon is the one lever that acts directly on churn rather than on the economic content. The five-year R&D stock is already slow-moving, so matching the gate's horizon to the leg's horizon should stabilize portfolio composition month to month while leaving the mechanism intact. If Sharpe rises above 0.62 with alpha near 6.6%, horizon matching is the correct final refinement rather than more conditioners.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Intangible Payback Versus Hidden Capital
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(SUB(RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), SUB(at, COALESCE(intan, 0)))), RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), MA(oancf, 3)), 1)))), RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)))
HYPOTHESIS: The right measure of acquired-intangible burden is how many years of operating cash flow the purchase price represents; a firm carrying ten years of cash flow in goodwill has paid for growth it may never deliver.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The short pole has been scaled by assets and by equity, but never by the cash flow that must ultimately justify the acquisition price, which is the economically exact payback framing and is more comparable across capital structures than either. Equity scaling already improved the standalone short signal (Sharpe −0.539, t −4.15), suggesting the scaling base matters, and cash-flow scaling extends that logic to a flow basis. Winsorization is essential because the payback ratio explodes for firms with near-zero cash flow.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Conjunctive Intangible Composition Gate
EXPRESSION: MUL(MUL(RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), SUB(at, COALESCE(intan, 0)))), RANK(NEG(RATIO(COALESCE(intan, 0), at)))), MIN(RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), RANK(NEG(RATIO(SUB(ib, oancf), at)))))
HYPOTHESIS: High hidden capital and low purchased intangibles are jointly necessary rather than mutually offsetting: a firm should score highly only if it both builds its own intangibles and has not bought them.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Every mix signal to date differences the two intangible ranks, which lets a very high organic score compensate for heavy goodwill, whereas the multiplicative form imposes a conjunction — exactly the structure that made MIN gating outperform SUMRANK averaging on the quality side. This is the last untested structural choice in the dominant family, and it distinguishes "composition premium" from "joint-condition premium." If it beats the differenced version, the final signal should be built conjunctively on both legs and the gate.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Magnitude-Preserving Intangible Mix
EXPRESSION: MUL(ZSCORE(SUB(RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), SUB(at, COALESCE(intan, 0)))), RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(intan, 0), at)))), RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)))
HYPOTHESIS: Firms at the extremes of the intangible-composition spectrum are the most severely mispriced, so the score should preserve how far a firm sits from the crossover point rather than compressing everything into a uniform rank.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The outer RANK in every mix signal discards the magnitude of the organic-minus-acquired gap, which flattens the difference between a marginal case and an extreme one and may be why the FMB slope has plateaued near 5.0 despite rising alphas. Standardizing the differenced legs instead keeps that magnitude while remaining scale-free and symmetric, and it costs nothing in coverage. This is an operator-structure test whose result tells the final generation whether to score the mechanism ordinally or metrically.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite
